signals.title: @mirek_szczerba: Yes of course Elie. The term “Indian spy intelligence in space” refers to the rapid expansion of India’s military spy satellite and intellig
signals.content: Yes of course Elie. The term “Indian spy intelligence in space” refers to the rapid expansion of India’s military spy satellite and intelligence systems (Space-Based Surveillance – SBS), as well as its next-generation space technologies. India has undergone a transformation from hiding its military assets from foreign spy satellites to building one of the most advanced orbital surveillance networks in the world. The key pillars of Indian space intelligence include: Project SBS-III: A Mega-Constellation of 52 Satellites The Indian government's Cabinet Committee on Security (CCS) approved a massive SBS-Phase III program valued at approximately INR 27,000 crore (around $3.2 billion). The Goal: Deploy 52 advanced spy satellites into Low Earth Orbit (LEO) and Geostationary Orbit (GEO). These satellites eliminate previous blind spots (such as a lack of nighttime visibility) and offer 24/7 real-time monitoring of borders, coastlines, and troop movements. They utilize advanced Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR), high-resolution optics, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) for inter-satellite communication. Space Intelligence Warfare and "Bodyguard Satellites" India's new defense doctrine recognizes space as a direct theater of intelligence operations. To protect its billion-dollar space infrastructure, India is developing "bodyguard satellites." Detect and neutralize hostile inspector satellites. Counter cyberattacks and signal jamming in orbit. Private Sector Success in "In-Orbit Snooping" Private Indian companies are working closely with ISRO and the military to deliver breakthrough technologies. The private satellite AFR (80 kg) achieved an unprecedented feat by tracking and photographing the International Space Station (ISS) from orbit. This demonstrated India's capability to conduct surveillance on other space assets and hostile satellites (known as in-orbit snooping). This startup launched the MOSAIC system and the SCOT (Space Camera for Object Tracking) satellite—the first commercial Space Situational Awareness (SSA) solution capable of detecting objects as small as 5 cm. Existing Intelligence Network (EMISAT, RISAT, Cartosat) The new constellation will join currently operational systems, such as the RISAT radar series, the Cartosat optical series, and the EMISAT satellite (managed by the NTRO). EMISAT is responsible for electronic intelligence (ELINT), locating adversary radars and communication systems directly from space... @CedricLeighton #India #Espionage

signals.content: OpenShell – A safe, private runtime for fleets of autonomous AI agents
signals.score_reason: live technology discussion signal; agentic AI relevance. Final score: 61. Freshness: source age 0.15d.
signals.brief_en: OpenShell is a privacy‑focused runtime designed to host multiple autonomous AI agents securely. It isolates each agent, encrypts inter‑agent communication, and logs activity for audit. Current assessments note limited public deployments; performance claims are unverified, and long‑term resilience against adversarial attacks remains uncertain.

Title: brockventures/Zero-Agent

ZERO (Zenith Engineering & Runtime Operator) is an autonomous AI systems engineering co‑pilot that orchestrates multi‑agent workflows on Discord. It provides runtime management, code generation, and integration support for complex automation tasks. Current capabilities include task scheduling, API bridging, and contextual code suggestions, but performance varies with workload complexity and platform constraints. Ongoing development aims to improve reliability, security, and scalability.
